notes.title: Achievement update
notes.notes:
Dear players,

We have some news to share with you regarding the game's achievements. We've recently made some updates to ensure that all achievements are fairly obtainable within the game. Regrettably, one achievement isn't earnable through typical gameplay, so developers had to add it manually time after time.

To maintain fairness for all players, we heavy-heartedly decided to remove this achievement. We understand this may be disappointing news for some of you, but be sure we are constantly striving to improve your gaming experience.

Thank you for your understanding and support.

notes.title: Adam Wolfe update has just been released!
notes.notes:
The biggest news is that the game is now localized into Dutch (in addition to English, French, German, Russian, Simplified Chinese and Serbian).

Also, all the issues that stopped you from running the game smoothly are resolved!

Have fun playing Adam Wolfe!
